articles.headline: Ambani's Jio IPO Bids Top 10 Times
articles.brief: Investors have heavily subscribed to Reliance's Jio IPO, with bids exceeding 10 times the offered shares, reflecting strong market confidence in the telecom and digital giant's public market debut.

articles.headline: Swiggy Shares Hit Record Low on Losses
articles.brief: Shares of Indian food delivery and quick-commerce major Swiggy plunged to a record low following widened losses in its rapid-delivery division, raising concerns among institutional investors over near-term profitability.

articles.headline: Volkswagen Workers Threaten Major Strikes
articles.brief: Automotive workers at Volkswagen have threatened widespread strikes unless management reverses recent decisions to cancel long-standing labor and employment security deals, escalating tensions across manufacturing plants.

articles.headline: Japan to Simulate Major Cyberattacks
articles.brief: In response to severe PHP vulnerabilities threatening the global internet infrastructure, Japanese authorities announced comprehensive nationwide simulations to test cyber resilience and critical response mechanisms.

articles.headline: China's DeepSeek and MiniMax Win AI Approval
articles.brief: State-affiliated entities report that Chinese artificial intelligence startups DeepSeek and MiniMax have received official regulatory approval for global deployment of their advanced AI models.

articles.headline: ICMR Project Aims at Breast Cancer Test
articles.brief: An ICMR-funded research initiative at GITAM aims to develop an affordable blood test for the early detection of triple-negative breast cancer, potentially revolutionizing diagnostic accessibility for patients.

articles.headline: WHO Reports First French Shamonda Virus Case
articles.brief: The World Health Organization confirmed the first human fatality from the livestock-borne Shamonda virus in France, prompting health authorities to evaluate potential cross-species transmission risks.

articles.headline: SBI Addresses Customer Data Leak Concerns
articles.brief: State Bank of India confirmed that thousands of customer records were flagged in a preliminary review of a cyber incident, assuring account balances remain safe while investigations continue.

articles.headline: Protesters March to Election Commission HQ
articles.brief: Civil society groups and trade unions marched toward the Election Commission headquarters in New Delhi, demanding electoral roll transparency and raising concerns over voting rights.

articles.headline: Elon Musk Political Donations Top $445M
articles.brief: Billionaire entrepreneur Elon Musk's political contributions have surpassed $445 million for the current US election cycle, positioning him as a leading donor supporting Republican candidates.

articles.headline: Iran Faces Mounting Global Oil Pressure
articles.brief: Tehran faces intensifying economic pressure and potential trade blockades concerning its petroleum exports, raising geopolitical concerns over possible retaliatory disruptions in regional shipping lanes.

articles.headline: US and South Korea Doubt Summit Prospects
articles.brief: Senior officials from the United States and South Korea have indicated minimal likelihood of a formal leadership summit between Washington and Pyongyang within the current calendar year.
